description.value: Double G Service is a landmark Alaska Highway stop at Mile 456, just south of Muncho Lake in remote northern BC, established in 1978 and run by owner-operator Jack Gunness. It offers touring cyclists a rare cluster of services in an isolated stretch of highway: a cafe renowned for homestyle breakfasts, a bakery with homemade bread and cookies, a convenience store, motel rooms, vehicle fuel, and even Canada Post service. Its longevity and breadth of services make it a well-known resupply and rest point for Alaska Highway travelers.

address.value: Mile 456 Alaska Highway, Muncho Lake, BC V0C 1R0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at doublegservice.com was successfully fetched and provides rich primary evidence. The amenities page explicitly lists a cafe with homestyle cooking, a bakery, fuel sales (unleaded and diesel), Canada Post service, a convenience store with snacks and beverages, and motel rooms with wifi. The contact page provides a physical street address (Mile 456 Alaska Highway, V0C 1R0) distinct from the PO Box in the footer. Neither bike parking, water refill, nor most optional amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Two different postal codes appear on the website: the footer PO Box uses V0C 1Z0 while the contact page street address uses V0C 1R0.
OSM tags this only as shop=convenience, but the business is a multi-service stop (cafe, bakery, motel, fuel, post office); Groceries is a partial fit.
OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced entirely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating multi-service highway stop confirmed by a live, detailed website; highly valuable to touring cyclists as one of very few serviced stops in this remote northern BC corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Fuel sales include regular unleaded and diesel. Canada Post mail service available on-site. Wifi included in motel rooms.

Hot food.detail: Amenities page lists 'Cafe with homestyle cooking'; About Us page describes 'highway-famous breakfasts' and homemade baked goods
